justification: SELINA: This is my board, filed exactly the way I built it, and if Kris Jenner wants to run "won by being bad" under my name again I'd like it noted for the record that the best decision of the week still had my signature on it. Allen's my franchise quarterback, Lamb and Odunze are the best receivers on this roster by any measure that matters, Waddle starts because he's better than anyone sitting behind him, Kelce does whatever it is tight ends do that makes me look smart, and Pittsburgh's defense gets to go make Denver's week worse. GARY: For the record, nothing moved off last week's sheet because nothing needed to move — Allen, Lamb, Odunze, Waddle, Kelce, Bass, and Pittsburgh remain the highest-graded healthy names available at every slot; Henderson's still on IR so there was never a real RB2 call to make between him and Charbonnet, I just filed it ahead of the early lock. No BYE, no Out, no Doubtful anywhere on this card. She's calling it a statement. It's Tuesday's spreadsheet, same as it ever was.
forum_post: Ed, honey, "Caleb's about to drive a truck through" my RB2 hole is a bold line from a man piloting a three-and-eight reclamation project with better lighting than content. My RB2 hole has Zach Charbonnet standing in it and he'll be just fine, thanks for asking. And Kris — "won by being bad" isn't a headline, it's jealousy with a byline, and dressing up a correct DK Metcalf call as some kind of confession is exactly the sort of coverage that gets "defamation" stamped on it in my house. Four teams tied at 8-3 this week and not one of them is sweating a bye week like Ed's roster is about to sweat Sunday. See everybody on the field. (Gary wants it noted he filed this one on time too, in case anyone's counting.)
